Noise range multiplier (%%)
Scales how far every one of this mod's actions carries. 100 is the default range, 200 is twice as far, 0 is silent. Forcing a door is the loudest act and picking a lock the quietest.
Prying, cutting, picking, filing and re-pinning make noise that zombies can hear. Metal is louder than wood, and higher Nimble makes every attempt quieter. Turn this off to work in total silence.
Apply balance updates to existing saves

When an update changes one of this mod's recommended settings, your existing save adopts the new value, but only for settings you have not changed yourself. Turn this off to freeze the numbers already stored in your save. Note that the Sandbox Options screen keeps showing the stored number even while the mod uses the updated one.
Allow cutting locks off with bolt cutters

Lets a player cut one of this mod's padlocks off with bolt cutters, keyed or combination alike. Turn off to remove the mechanic entirely, leaving a padlock answerable only to its key, its combination or a lockpick.
Allow fitting combination padlocks

Lets a player fit a combination padlock, which takes a 4-digit code instead of a key. If off, combination locks already fitted still work and can still be removed, but no new one can be fitted. Keyed padlocks have their own switch.
Allow forcing doors with a crowbar
Lets a player pry a locked door open with a crowbar. Padlocked gates are never a crowbar target. Turn off to remove the mechanic entirely.
Doors can be destroyed

If on, a door whose health is driven to zero by prying is destroyed, leaves the square and drops whatever it was made of. If off, a door's health always stops at 1 and force can never break it open. A door carrying one of this mod's padlocks is never destroyed either way.
Allow installing locks
If off, existing locks still work but no new locks can be installed.
Allow cutting keys for locks

Lets a player file a blank key to match an unlocked lock: both Cut New Key For Lock and the blank that arms a freshly fitted padlock. Turn off and a padlock fitted afterwards can never be given a key. Vehicles have their own switch.
Allow renaming keys
Adds a rename entry to the right-click menu of any key, so a key ring stops being a pile of identical keys. Turn off to remove the entry; names already given are kept.
Allow repairing broken locks
Lets a player fit a replacement cylinder to a door or car door whose lock was wrecked, using a screwdriver, one scrap metal and two screws. Turn this off to make a wrecked lock permanent.
Allow lockpicking
Lets a player try a locked door with a screwdriver and a paperclip. Turn off to remove the mechanic entirely.
Allow re-pinning locks
Lets a player re-pin an unlocked padlock or doorknob onto a key they already carry, using tweezers. Turn off to remove the mechanic entirely. Vehicles have their own switch.
Allow breaching security doors

If on, the barred metal doors at police stations and similar buildings can be picked and pried like any other locked door, only harder. If off, they refuse both outright and neither entry appears on them at all.
Allow forcing vehicle locks

Lets a player pry a locked car door or trunk open with a crowbar, using the same odds, the same endurance cost and the same Strength XP as forcing a house door. The lock is left permanently broken and can never be locked again, and the part takes some damage. Forcing doors with a crowbar must be allowed as well.
Allow keying vehicle locks
Lets a player re-pin a car's locks to a vehicle key they already carry, or cut a new car key from a blank. Both require standing at a door that is already unlocked.
Allow picking vehicle locks
Lets a player pick a locked car door, trunk or hood with a screwdriver and a paperclip, with the same odds, the same tool wear and the same XP as a house lock. Lockpicking must be allowed as well.
Bolt cutter base chance (%%)
Base success chance to cut off a lock with bolt cutters, before Strength bonus.
Bolt cutters degrade on use
Bolt cutters lose condition on every attempt to cut a lock, and lose more condition on a failed attempt. Off reverts to the old behaviour: only a failed attempt damages them.
Bolt cutter endurance cost
Endurance spent by one cutting attempt, before Fitness and Strength reduce it. Endurance runs from 0 to 1, so 0.02 is two per cent of a full bar.
Failed bolt cut Strength XP
Failed bolt cut XP chance (%%)
Chance that a failed cut awards its Strength XP at all.
Strength XP awarded for a failed cut, the way a failed lockpick already pays a little.
Bolt cutter max chance (%%)
Upper cap on the bolt cutter success chance.
Bolt cutter minimum time (ticks)
Floor on the cutting time; the Strength time reduction can never take a cut below this.
Bolt cutter chance per Strength
Added success chance (%%) per level of the Strength perk.
Bolt cutter time saved per Strength
Ticks removed from the cutting time for each level of the Strength perk. Higher Strength cuts faster.
Bolt cutter time (ticks)
How long a single cutting attempt takes.
Bolt cutter wear chance (%%)
Chance that one cutting attempt wears the bolt cutters, at Strength 0. A failed attempt rolls this twice.
Bolt cutter wear max chance (%%)
Upper cap on the bolt cutter wear chance.
Bolt cutter wear min chance (%%)
Floor on the bolt cutter wear chance.
Bolt cutter wear chance per Strength
Wear chance (%%) removed per level of the Strength perk. A stronger pair of hands chews the tool less.
Bolt cutter Strength XP
Bolt cutter XP chance (%%)
Chance that a successful cut awards Strength XP at all. Keeps cutting from becoming the fastest way to grind Strength.
Strength XP awarded for cutting off a lock somebody else installed. Cutting your own lock never pays.
Crowbar base chance (%%)
Success chance for a single forcing attempt before the Strength bonus.
Chance a successful pry wrecks the lock (%%)
When a crowbar forces a door open, this is the chance its lock is wrecked in the process. A wrecked lock cannot be locked again until someone repairs it. Set to 0 to leave every forced door lockable.
Crowbar door damage chance (%%)
Chance that a single pry marks the door at all, for an unskilled character. Nimble, Strength and Fitness all lower it, with Nimble counting three times as much as either of the others.
Crowbar max door damage (%%)

Damage a marking pry does at zero skill, as a percentage of that door's own maximum health. It falls with Nimble, Strength and Fitness to the floor set by Crowbar door damage. A failed pry does a little over half as much.
Crowbar damage min chance (%%)
Floor on the chance that a pry marks the door, reached at maximum Nimble, Strength and Fitness.
Crowbar door damage (%%)
Damage each forcing attempt does to the door, as a percentage of that door's own maximum health. The door is never destroyed: its health always stops at 1.
Crowbar endurance cost

Endurance spent by one forcing attempt, before Fitness and Strength reduce it. Endurance runs from 0 to 1, so 0.03 is three per cent of a full bar. A tired character is also less likely to succeed, but is never stopped from trying.
Failed force Strength XP
Failed force XP chance (%%)
Chance that a failed forcing attempt awards its Strength XP at all.
Strength XP awarded for a failed forcing attempt.
Crowbar max chance (%%)
Upper cap on the forcing success chance. Deliberately below the bolt cutter cap.
Crowbar chance per Strength
Added success chance (%%) per level of the Strength perk.
Forcing requires the magazine
If on, only a character who has learned to copy building keys may force a door. Off by default -- prying a door open is common sense, not locksmithing.
Crowbar vehicle part damage
Condition points a forcing attempt takes off the car door or trunk that was pried, whether or not the lock gives. A part's condition never falls below 1, so forcing can never destroy one outright.
Crowbar wear chance (%%)
Chance that one forcing attempt wears the crowbar, at Strength 0. A failed attempt rolls this twice.
Crowbar wear max chance (%%)
Upper cap on the crowbar wear chance.
Crowbar wear min chance (%%)
Floor on the crowbar wear chance.
Crowbar wear chance per Strength
Wear chance (%%) removed per level of the Strength perk.
Crowbar Strength XP
Crowbar XP chance (%%)
Chance that a successful force awards Strength XP at all.
Strength XP awarded the first time a character forces a given door.
Bolt cutting requires knowledge

Bolt cutting a lock off requires having read the magazine that teaches CopyBuildingKey (or the Burglar profession), the same as lock picking. Off by default -- cutting a lock is a mechanical task, not a locksmithing one.
Car key cutting base chance (%%)

Chance of cutting a working car key from a blank at Nimble 0. A failed cut still uses up the blank and wears the small file set twice over. Set this to 100 to restore the behaviour of earlier versions, where the cut always succeeded.
Car key cutting maximum chance (%%)
Upper limit on the car key cutting chance, however high Nimble goes.
Car key cutting chance per Nimble level
Success chance added for every level of Nimble. At the default values the cut becomes a certainty at Nimble 4.
Enable Locksmith
Master switch. When off, no install/lock/unlock/remove options appear.
Small file set degrades on use
The small file set loses condition every time a key is cut with it, and loses more on a failed car key cut. Off stops the file set wearing out at all.
Install time (ticks)
How long the install action takes. Lock/unlock/remove use short fixed times.
Only owner can remove
If on, only the player who installed a lock may remove it.
Lockpick base chance (%%)
Success chance for a single pick attempt before the Nimble bonus.
Paperclip break chance (%%)
Chance that a failed pick snaps the paperclip, at Nimble 0.
Paperclip break max chance (%%)
Upper cap on the chance that a failed pick snaps the paperclip.
Paperclip break min chance (%%)
Floor on the break chance; the Nimble reduction can never take it below this.
Paperclip break chance per Nimble
Break chance (%%) removed per level of the Nimble perk. A steadier hand ruins fewer paperclips.
Screwdriver damage chance (%%)
Chance that a failed pick wears the screwdriver, at Nimble 0. Always lower than the paperclip break chance.
Screwdriver damage max chance (%%)
Upper cap on the chance that a failed pick wears the screwdriver.
Screwdriver damage min chance (%%)
Floor on the screwdriver damage chance.
Screwdriver damage chance per Nimble
Damage chance (%%) removed per level of the Nimble perk.
Failed lockpick Nimble XP
Failed lockpick XP chance (%%)
Chance that a failed pick awards its Nimble XP at all.
Nimble XP awarded for a failed pick attempt, the way vanilla pays a little for a botched vehicle part install.
Lockpick max chance (%%)
Upper cap on the pick success chance.
Lockpick minimum time (ticks)
Floor on the pick time; the Nimble reduction can never take an attempt below this.
Lockpick chance per Nimble
Added success chance (%%) per level of the Nimble perk.
Lockpicking requires the magazine
If on, only a character who has learned to copy building keys may pick a lock.
Lockpick time saved per Nimble
Ticks removed from the pick time for each level of the Nimble perk.
Lockpick time (ticks)
How long a single pick attempt takes before the Nimble reduction.
Lockpick Nimble XP
Lockpick XP chance (%%)
Chance that a first successful pick awards Nimble XP at all. Re-picking a door you have already opened never pays.
Nimble XP awarded the first time a character picks a given door.
Refund lock on removal
If on, removing a gate lock returns a Gate Lock item to the player.
Lock repair chance at Nimble 0 (%%)
The chance of seating a replacement cylinder with no Nimble at all. Every attempt uses up the parts, win or lose.
Maximum lock repair chance (%%)
The ceiling the repair chance can reach however high Nimble climbs.
Lock repair chance gained per Nimble level (%%)
Added to the base chance for each level of Nimble. At the defaults a repair is certain from Nimble 4 upward.
Repairing a lock requires knowing how
Requires the Burglar profession or reading The Cheapskate's John Spiral - Escaping Captivity before a broken lock can be repaired. Turn this off to let anyone with the parts do it.
Re-pinning requires knowledge

If on, re-pinning a lock to another key, cutting a fresh key for a door you built, and cutting the blank that arms a padlock all require having read the key-cutting magazine or being a Burglar. If off, none of them do.
Require a screwdriver
Design hook for requiring a screwdriver to install/remove a lock (not yet enforced).
Security door difficulty

How much harder a security door is than an ordinary one. The chance to pick it, the chance to pry it and the damage a pry does are all divided by this number, so 2.5 means about two and a half times the work. The lowest setting, 1.0, makes a security door no harder than any other door.
Security doors cannot be destroyed

If on, a security door's health always stops at 1 and force can never break it open, even where doors can be destroyed everywhere else. Prime loot then sits behind a lock that has to be defeated rather than a frame that can be smashed.
Per-object XP latch
If on, once a player has successfully picked or cut a given lock, no further pick or cut attempt on it pays that player XP again, win or lose. If off, XP pays every time as before.
Consume a blank key to cut the key for this padlock and arm the lock. Needs a blank key and a small file set; the file is kept.
Set a new 4-digit code. Everyone else will need the new code.
Cut a fresh key for this lock from a blank key and a small file set, reading the pin stack with tweezers. The new key becomes the only key that opens it. The lock has to be unlocked first.
Cut this lock off with bolt cutters. Higher Strength improves the odds.
Requires knowing how a lock is put together.
Higher Nimble places the jaws better, so the blades last longer.
Type the 4-digit code to open this lock.
Pry the door open with a crowbar. Higher Strength improves the odds and spares the tool. Padlocked gates need bolt cutters or a lockpick instead.
Each pry may mark the door, and higher Nimble, Strength and Fitness all make that less likely. A door driven to zero health is destroyed.
Forcing a lock like this is hard work. Every attempt costs endurance, and a tired character has worse odds. Higher Strength and Fitness make each attempt cost less.
Requires knowing how a lock is put together.
Opens and locks the gate this key was cut for. Weightless.

Install on a player-built gate to bind a unique key, letting you lock it against anyone without that key. Keep that key in your main inventory, or on a keyring there, or the Lock and Unlock options will not appear.
Install a combination padlock and set a 4-digit code. Anyone who knows the code can open it.
This door is already locked. Unlock or defeat that lock before installing one of your own.
Also covers locks: cutting a spare key, re-pinning a door to a key you already carry, cutting a lock off with bolt cutters, and picking a door with a screwdriver and a paperclip.
Gates and garage doors you find in the world work too, not just ones you built.
This lock is shut. Open it first -- with its key, a lockpick or a crowbar -- before you can re-key it.
Tweezers are needed to read the pin stack before a key can be cut for it.
With Locksmith, this can also be installed on a player-built gate to lock it, and cut off with bolt cutters if the key is lost.
Work the lock with a screwdriver and a paperclip. Higher Nimble means a better chance, a faster attempt, and fewer ruined tools when it goes wrong. Even a failure teaches you something.
Remove this keyed gate lock.

Fit a replacement cylinder with a screwdriver, one scrap metal and two screws. Higher Nimble means a better chance of seating it; the parts are used up whether it works or not. A door with a wrecked lock cannot be locked again until it is repaired.
Re-pin your installed keyed lock to an existing gate key. Requires tweezers nearby.
Re-pin this lock with tweezers so a key you already carry opens it too. The key keeps everything it already opens.
Requires knowing how to re-pin a lock.
This is a security door. Picking its lock and prying its frame are both far harder than on an ordinary door.
